name: ControlNet and structural control adapters (SD1.5 / SDXL / FLUX.1 / SD3.5 / Qwen-Image / Z-Image)
publisher: lllyasviel (SD1.5 v1.1); xinsir (SDXL union); Stability AI (SD3.5 nets, Control-LoRA); Black Forest Labs (FLUX.1 Canny/Depth); InstantX / Shakker-Labs / XLabs (FLUX unions); InstantX + DiffSynth-Studio + alibaba-pai (Qwen-Image); alibaba-pai (Z-Image Fun)
stage_kind: adapter: every recipe is a FRAGMENT WITH AN ANCHOR - a full minimal graph for one host family whose recipe.anchor says which node ids belong to the host and which to the adapter, so a pipeline can splice the adapter nodes into that host's own recipe

cannot.what: turn a photo into a control map by itself: 'Each ControlNet/T2I adapter needs the image that is passed to it to be in a specific format like depthmaps, canny maps and so on ... The ControlNetApply node will not convert regular images' (preprocess with native Canny / Lotus / DA3 / SDPose or the aux pack)
pick a mode on FLUX Union Pro 2.0 with SetUnionControlNetType: 'Mode embedding removed' - the node is a no-op; the preprocessed image alone selects the behaviour
tile / repaint with the plain xinsir union file: 'Control type ... is out of range ... Please consider using the ProMax ControlNet Union model'
load the Qwen-Image-2.1 Fun union natively on the 0.35.0 image (needs ComfyUI >= v0.38.0)

give per-GPU VRAM numbers: no official tables exist for any ControlNet; rule of thumb from ComfyUI_examples - the net 'is run once every iteration', so add roughly its file size (in working dtype) to the host's footprint; T2I-Adapters run once in total

params.name: strength
params.meaning: multiplies the control residuals; 0 = node bypass. Qwen / Z-Image Fun nets are applied as sqrt(strength) ('Fun checkpoints are more sensitive to high strengths ... strength=1.0 stays unchanged while >1 grows more gently')

publisher.FLUX Union Pro 2.0: canny 0.7, soft edge 0.7, depth 0.8, pose 0.9, gray 0.9
publisher.Qwen/Z-Image Fun: 1.0 (soft-scaled); MiniMax template: 'Raise strength above 1 only if the control drifts'

params.name: start_percent / end_percent
params.meaning: fraction of the sampling schedule during which the net is active ('0.2 means ControlNet guidance begins when 20% of diffusion is complete'); a lower end frees the last steps for detail

params.name: vae
params.meaning: REQUIRED by latent-space hint nets - SD3.5, FLUX InstantX/Shakker unions, Qwen InstantX / Fun; QwenImageDiffsynthControlnet and ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply take vae as a required input. SD1.5 / SDXL (xinsir, Control-LoRA) are pixel-space: leave it unwired

params.name: type
params.meaning: selects the task embedding of a union net; auto sends an empty list (xinsir: hint goes through the plain input_hint_block without the task branch). Indices: openpose 0, depth 1, hed/pidi/scribble/ted 2, canny/lineart/anime_lineart/mlsd 3, normal 4, segment 5, tile 6, repaint 7
params.flux_union_mapping: InstantX / Shakker Pro 1.0 reuse the SDXL labels by INDEX: openpose->0 canny, depth->1 tile, hed/pidi/scribble/ted->2 depth, canny/lineart/anime_lineart/mlsd->3 blur, normal->4 pose, segment->5 gray, tile->6 low quality (ComfyUI issue #4823, open; confirmed by the source paths)

params.name: strength (model patch)
params.meaning: the patch-style control's weight (Qwen DiffSynth patches, Z-Image Fun union)

params.name: canny thresholds
params.meaning: native edge detector; DiT templates use low values (0.1-0.35), SD3.5 0.3/0.6, SD1.5 0.35/0.8; node defaults 0.4/0.8

params.name: guidance
params.meaning: FLUX distilled guidance; the control templates set it per model

params.name: shift
params.meaning: 'Increase the shift if you get too many blurry/dark/bad images. Decrease if you want to try increasing detail.'

params.name: steps / cfg
params.meaning: the host's values; control nets do not change them

params.name: control image size
params.meaning: the templates either scale the control image to the latent (SD3.5 canny: 1024x1024 center) or derive the latent from the control image (GetImageSize -> EmptySD3LatentImage; VAEEncode of the map as latent_image). Qwen caps 1-1.68 MP or 1536 px; Z-Image: enable the 1024 scale above ~2500 px; InstantX inpaint 'shouldn't be too large (such as more than 3000)'

params.name: resolution
params.meaning: detection resolution, output resized back; >= generation size for crisp maps (community practice)

params.name: chaining
params.input: positive/negative of the previous apply node
params.meaning: a second apply node fed by the first's outputs runs both nets (set_previous_controlnet), each with its own strength/start/end; docs: 'recommended to set similar strength values' (both 1.0 in the openpose+scribble example)

rules.message: a union ControlNet (xinsir SDXL / FLUX union) needs SetUnionControlNetType between the loader and the apply node. Qwen-Image's InstantX union is the exception: its official template uses none.

prefer an explicit SetUnionControlNetType type over 'auto': a union ControlNet needs SetUnionControlNetType between loader and apply with an explicit type: 'auto' sends an empty list and the hint bypasses the task embedding (xinsir); FLUX Union Pro 2.0 is the one exception (no mode embedder - the node is a no-op there)
tile and repaint exist only in the ProMax union file; the plain xinsir union raises 'Control type ... is out of range ... Please consider using the ProMax ControlNet Union model'
ControlNetApply is DEPRECATED in v0.35.0 (one conditioning, applies to uncond too); use ControlNetApplyAdvanced with positive + negative (+ vae where required)
SD3.5, FLUX InstantX/Shakker unions and Qwen InstantX/Fun nets condition in latent space: wire the host VAE into the apply node (every official template does)
BFL FLUX.1 Canny/Depth [dev] are full transformers (UNETLoader, diffusion_models) or LoRAs (LoraLoaderModelOnly), conditioned with InstructPixToPixConditioning - never models/controlnet files
flux1-canny-dev / flux1-depth-dev read the control image through InstructPixToPixConditioning (positive, negative, vae, pixels -> positive, negative, latent); without it they are a broken flux1-dev
the BFL Canny/Depth LoRAs go on a flux1-dev model (fp8 or bf16) and still need InstructPixToPixConditioning for the control image
a FLUX control LoRA without InstructPixToPixConditioning gets no control image
FLUX control templates run cfg 1.0 with ConditioningZeroOut as negative; guidance comes from FluxGuidance
the official Canny-dev template sets FluxGuidance 30 (not the usual 3.5)
the official Depth-LoRA template sets FluxGuidance 10
sd3.5_large_controlnet_* nets are SD3.5 Large nets (the loader reads their embedded control_type); load them on an sd3.5_large checkpoint
Stability: 'Start with a ControlNet strength of 0.7-0.8'; templates use 0.66 (canny), 0.7 (depth), 1.0 (blur)
xinsir: 'Default setting is 1.0 for each condition input'

FLUX InstantX / Shakker Pro 1.0 unions take the SetUnionControlNetType INDEX, not its label: openpose=0 canny, depth=1 tile, hed/pidi/scribble/ted=2 depth, canny/lineart/anime_lineart/mlsd=3 blur, normal=4 pose, segment=5 gray, tile=6 low quality (issue #4823). Pro 2.0 ignores the node entirely. Name the file so this rule can see it (the HF name is the generic diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors).
FLUX Union Pro 1.0: conditioning scale 0.3-0.8 (InstantX examples 0.5 single / 0.2-0.4 multi); Pro 2.0: canny 0.7, soft edge 0.7, depth 0.8, pose 0.9, gray 0.9 with end_percent 0.8 (0.65 pose)
InstantX recommends controlnet_conditioning_scale 0.8-1.0 for all four Qwen union types
the Qwen InstantX inpainting net (17-channel concat_mask) is applied with ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply (positive, negative, control_net, vae, image, mask), not ControlNetApplyAdvanced
Fun nets are already soft-scaled by sqrt(strength) in ComfyUI ('more sensitive to high strengths'); stay at 1.0 - 'Raise strength above 1 only if the control drifts' (MiniMax template)
alibaba-pai: 'optimal range for control_context_scale is from 0.65 to 0.80'; the template ships 1.0 - lower it if the control dominates

DiffSynth / Z-Image Fun control files are MODEL PATCHES (models/model_patches): ModelPatchLoader -> QwenImageDiffsynthControlnet(model, model_patch, vae, image) on the model line - not ControlNetLoader
with the 4-step Lightning LoRA the templates run cfg 1.0 (table: fp8 20 steps / cfg 2.5; + Lightning 4 steps / cfg 1.0)
4-step distilled LoRA: more steps waste time and over-bake
every Qwen control template sets ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1; raise if blurry/dark, lower for detail (template note)
Z-Image-Turbo is distilled: cfg 1, 8 steps, res_multistep/simple, negative = ConditioningZeroOut (template)
ControlNet v1.1 / T2I-Adapter sd14/sd15 files are SD1.5 only
Qwen-Image-2.1 Fun union loads natively only from ComfyUI v0.38.0 - above the pinned 0.35.0 image

the control map must have the latent's size/aspect: the templates scale the map to the latent (ImageScale 1024x1024 center), size the latent from the map (GetImageSize -> EmptySD3LatentImage) or VAE-encode the map as the latent; a mismatched map is stretched
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image (all 13 recipes here are <= 0.8.0; Qwen-2.1 Fun needs 0.38.0)

prompting.negative_note: ControlNet is prompt-independent conditioning - the negative belongs to the HOST. cfg-1 DiT templates (FLUX, Qwen + Lightning, Z-Image) use ConditioningZeroOut as negative; the Qwen InstantX templates use '' / ' '; the Qwen-2512 template ships the Chinese negative kept in qwen2512-fun-union-canny: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲

positive.line: Write the host's normal prompt; the map decides structure, the prompt decides content and style - describe what fills the edges/depth, not the layout
Z-Image Fun: a 'detailed prompt' is recommended for stability
Qwen InstantX: 'Set cfg to 1.0 for a speed boost at the cost of consistency. Samplers like res_multistep work pretty well at cfg 1.0'

prompting.structure: the host family's prompt rules apply unchanged

hurts.line: feeding a raw photo where a map is expected: the net reads it as the wrong signal
a prompt that contradicts the map (the net wins on layout, the result fights)

pitfalls.symptom: union net ignores the chosen condition / behaves like a weak generic net
pitfalls.cause: SetUnionControlNetType left on auto (xinsir), or a FLUX union with the SDXL-labelled type picked by name instead of index
pitfalls.fix: set the type explicitly; on FLUX InstantX / Shakker Pro 1.0 pick by position (see rules); Pro 2.0 ignores the node

pitfalls.symptom: 'Control type ... is out of range ... Please consider using the ProMax ControlNet Union model'
pitfalls.cause: tile / repaint chosen with the plain xinsir union file

pitfalls.symptom: latent-hint net errors or produces garbage
pitfalls.cause: vae not wired into ControlNetApplyAdvanced for SD3.5 / FLUX InstantX-Shakker / Qwen InstantX-Fun
pitfalls.fix: wire the host VAE (all official templates do)

pitfalls.symptom: 'ERROR: controlnet file is invalid' for flux1-canny-dev / flux1-depth-dev
pitfalls.cause: a full BFL control transformer dropped into models/controlnet

pitfalls.symptom: output ignores the control or follows a blurry version of the photo
pitfalls.cause: raw photo fed as the control image
pitfalls.fix: preprocess first: native Canny / Lotus / DA3 / SDPose, or comfyui_controlnet_aux (profile.preprocessors)

pitfalls.symptom: Fun / Z-Image control dominates, flat or over-constrained result
pitfalls.cause: strength above the author's range; ComfyUI already sqrt-scales Fun strengths
pitfalls.fix: Z-Image Fun 0.65-0.80; Qwen Fun 1.0 (above 1 only if the control drifts)

pitfalls.symptom: poor results with a large input
pitfalls.fix: Qwen templates cap at 1-1.68 MP or 1536 px max side; Z-Image: enable ImageScaleToMaxDimension(1024) above ~2500 px; InstantX inpaint: keep under ~3000 px

pitfalls.symptom: depth-controlled SD3.5 image looks inverted (near/far swapped)
pitfalls.cause: the SD3.5 depth net expects DepthFM-style maps and ComfyUI applies 1.0 - a internally; a map of the opposite polarity flips twice
pitfalls.fix: the Lotus chain's ImageInvert output is what the template feeds; with another depth source, flip the map (ImageInvert) if results invert

pitfalls.cause: control map and latent sizes differ
pitfalls.fix: scale the map to the latent or size the latent from the map (GetImageSize / VAEEncode), as the templates do

pitfalls.symptom: 'Please use the preprocessed images' / blur net does nothing useful
pitfalls.cause: SD3.5 blur expects an already blurred / low-res image
pitfalls.fix: blur or downscale the image first (or install comfyui_controlnet_aux), template note

pitfalls.cause: old ComfyUI_examples pattern; the node is deprecated and applies to uncond too

pitfalls.symptom: Qwen-Image-2.1 Fun union fails to load
pitfalls.fix: not available on the 0.35.0 image; use the 2512 Fun union or InstantX union
